name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, and Pi. 44 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: A skill that makes AI coding assistants draw clean, good-looking diagrams for your docs instead of ugly default flowcharts.
buyer: A technical writer or startup founder who needs polished architecture diagrams for a pitch deck or developer docs but has no designer on staff.
business_use_cases: A startup founder uses it to generate investor-deck-quality system diagrams straight from their codebase, skipping a freelance designer.
A developer-tools company bakes it into their docs pipeline so every architecture diagram in their documentation matches their brand automatically.
A technical writing agency offers 'AI-diagrammed docs' as a faster, cheaper add-on service to clients who need clean visuals for engineering documentation.

money_ideas.idea: Sell premium diagram themes/brand kits built on top of the free open-source skill.
Offer a documentation agency service that uses this skill to produce client diagrams at scale.

steal_this: Spin up a tiny 'docs diagram cleanup' gig: take a client's existing messy Mermaid diagrams and re-generate them with this skill for a flat per-diagram fee.
